name: Port Killer
author: jesusarchive
description: See which processes are listening on which ports and kill them from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Lists listening ports with the process, project directory, and uptime behind each one. Kill one, force kill, or kill all of yours. Root-owned ports are killed through the polkit password dialog.

schema.label: Only these ports
schema.description: Optional. Ports or ranges such as 3000,5173,8000-8999. Empty shows every port.

schema.label: Ignore ports
schema.description: Ports or ranges to hide, such as 53,631.

schema.label: Ignore processes
schema.description: Process or systemd unit names to hide, such as cups,avahi-daemon.

schema.label: Show system ports
schema.description: Ports owned by root or other users. Killing one asks for your password.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is listening
schema.description: Hide the bar icon while none of your processes hold a port.
